purpose: freeze every remaining implementation degree of freedom BEFORE Phase 25 so Phase 25 cannot silently choose architecture or protocol based on observed performance

roi.roi_rule: predicted foreground -> tight bbox -> center-preserving 1.50x expansion -> clip -> square pad -> resize to 256x256
roi.reason_256: dedicated regional crop provides zoom; substantially lower incremental compute than another full 512 pass; consistent with the resource-aware goal; selected prospectively, NOT from performance. This is a DESIGN CHOICE, not a claim that 256 is optimal.

refiner.name: BARRRegionalRefinerV1

architecture.head: final 1x1 Conv2d to 1 logit channel (with bias)

refiner.residual_block_spec: Conv3x3 -> GroupNorm -> SiLU -> Conv3x3 -> GroupNorm -> residual addition -> SiLU
refiner.conv_bias: bias=False for convolutions followed by GroupNorm
refiner.groupnorm_groups: prefer 8 groups where channel count permits, otherwise the largest divisor <= 8 chosen deterministically
refiner.task_conditioning_reason: the refiner is not the novelty-bearing component and task_id already enters the benefit router; keeping R_psi simple reduces degrees of freedom. A task-conditioned refiner is a future controlled ablation only.
refiner.amp: enabled when supported by the training device
refiner.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation loss (primary); Dice recorded as secondary diagnostic only
refiner.parameter_count_method: closed-form architecture arithmetic; no module instantiated
refiner.envelope_reduction_rule: declared channels [16,32,64,128,192] with one residual block per stage compute to 2,317,553 params, which EXCEEDS the 2,000,000 hard ceiling. Before any training, and without consulting any outcome, the pre-declared deterministic reduction [16,32,64,96,128] (one residual block per stage) is adopted, giving 1,276,401 params - inside the recommended 0.5M-1.5M envelope. Channels may NOT be changed after observing performance.

crossfit.inner_split_purpose: the held-out OOF fold may be used only for OOF prediction/label creation, never checkpoint selection; a nested TRAIN-INTERNAL 90/10 fitting/early-stop split is created inside each refiner-training portion so early stopping never touches the OOF target fold
crossfit.oof_fold_role: UNTOUCHED until prediction, then used only for OOF gain labels

final_refiner.name: R_psi_final
final_refiner.refit_rule: after the three OOF refiner runs have produced gain labels, train ONE final regional refiner on ALL executable-action ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT samples
final_refiner.epoch_rule: reinitialize BARRRegionalRefinerV1 from seed 42 and train for exactly the median integer best epoch of the three OOF refiner runs (prospectively determined)
sole_regional_refiner_for: future Phase 26+ development unless explicitly superseded

router.name: BARRBenefitRouterV1
router.roi_pool_mapping: ROI-aware average pool mapped to that feature grid
router.normalization: mean/std computed on ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT only for scalar continuous descriptors
router.architecture: Linear(input_dim,128) -> LayerNorm(128) -> SiLU -> Dropout(0.10) -> Linear(128,64) -> LayerNorm(64) -> SiLU -> Dropout(0.10) -> Linear(64,1)
router.harm_head: NOT part of the primary router; pre-registered extension only
router.loss_reason: paired gain can contain extreme harmed/improved cases; Huber is robust while preserving continuous-gain supervision
router.epoch_selection: deterministic 5-fold group-safe cross-validation inside ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT OOF gain rows
router.final_training: B_phi_final trained on all eligible ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT gain rows for the median selected epoch count
router.parameter_count_method: closed-form architecture arithmetic; no module instantiated
router.envelope_reduction_rule: if the fixed feature dimensionality causes >250k params, hidden dimensions are reduced deterministically 128->96 and 64->48 and documented before training; features are NEVER reduced based on outcome performance

routing.fixed_budget_routing: thresholds from ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT score quantiles only
routing.cost_scale_derivation: architecture arithmetic only, never outcome metrics

post_safety.name: BARRPostSafetyV1
post_safety.primary_evaluation: A7 / benefit + resource gate WITHOUT post-safety
post_safety.target_source: OOF refinement predictions from ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT only

fusion.rule: outside frozen ROI: p_final_candidate = p_global; inside frozen ROI: p_final_candidate = resized p_refined

action_availability.purpose: distinguish 'predicted negative benefit' from 'no legal refinement action exists'

additional_requested_operations.vertical_flip: NOT_INHERITED (the inherited pipeline defines no vertical flip)
additional_requested_operations.90_degree_rotation_set: NOT_INHERITED (the inherited pipeline uses continuous +/-5 degree rotation, not a {0,90,180,270} set)

augmentation.inheritance_decision: Per the repair instruction, existing frozen Phase-20/21 augmentation constants are inherited EXACTLY rather than replaced with new invented operations. The inherited pipeline does not define vertical flip or 90-degree rotation, so those two operations are recorded as NOT_INHERITED and are NOT added to the primary refiner.
augmentation.p_global_crop_consistency: the p_global crop is transformed with the SAME geometric operations as the RGB crop (nearest resample for any mask-like/probability array)

forbidden_tuning_sources: any outcome-driven architecture or channel change
any outcome-driven lambda or threshold selection
